title: 第三章 烬棘红莲以身护誓第四章 神域残响双生预兆
slug: 星冕天启守护者觉醒录
lines: 暮色彻底浸染琉光星冕综合学园的整片天地时，白日里喧嚣热闹的校园已然褪去所有鲜活烟火气。
层层叠叠的墨色夜幕自天际尽头缓缓铺展，吞噬掉最后一缕落日余晖，澄澈的夜空之上零星点缀着细碎疏朗的星子，微弱的星光隔着厚重的夜色洒落，落在成片错落的教学楼顶、平整开阔的运动场上、郁郁葱葱的星纹梧桐林里，给整座静谧的学园镀上了一层清冷单薄的银白柔光。
晚风穿过林立的楼宇缝隙，携带着入夜之后的微凉水汽缓缓游走，卷起道路两侧行道树上簌簌飘落的金黄枯叶，叶片翻飞盘旋，落在光洁的青石板路面上，发出轻柔细碎的摩擦声响，成了寂静夜色里唯一鲜活的动静。
白日历经两场暗影魔物突袭、数次灵力消耗的校园，此刻已然被彻底净化干净，空气之中再也寻不到半分阴冷暴戾的暗黑戾气，只剩下晚风裹挟的草木清香与夜晚独有的清冽气息，安宁平和，静谧温柔，仿佛白天那场惊心动魄的密林鏖战、席卷全校的暗黑危机，都只是转瞬即逝的一场虚幻梦境。
可唯有亲身立于黑暗宿命中心的两人清楚，平静表象之下，暗流早已汹涌蛰伏，致命的危机从来没有真正远离过这座被暗影势力暗中盯上的学园。
高二（1）班的教学楼早已灯火稀疏，整栋楼层大半教室都已熄灭照明灯光，只剩下走廊两侧零星的应急夜灯散发着柔和暖光，浅浅照亮空旷寂静的走廊。晚自习结束的铃声落下已有一刻钟之久，全校学生几乎尽数离校归家，留校自习的少数学生也早已收拾书包离开，偌大的教学区域彻底褪去白日的人声鼎沸，陷入沉沉静谧。
天野凛星独自一人坐在靠窗的座位上，没有如同往常一般准时收拾书本离校。
教室的玻璃窗完全敞开，微凉的晚风顺着窗口涌入，轻轻掀动少年额前细碎的黑发，也吹动了桌角摊开的课本纸页，纸张轻轻翻卷，发出规律轻柔的哗啦声响。少年身姿挺拔端正，脊背笔直靠在椅背之上，双目轻阖，神色沉静安然，周身气息松弛却并未彻底卸下戒备，整个人处于深度调息的状态之中。
白日接连不断的高强度作战，依旧在他的身体里留下了难以消解的灵力损耗与肢体酸胀。
清晨直面数百暗影魔物的集群围攻，全程不间断催动冰圣双本源灵力，接连施展四大本命招式全域清剿、结界护生、净化黑暗；午休时分走遍校园边角缝隙，一寸寸排查、净化潜藏的暗影残渣，持续消耗稀薄灵力维持全域感知；下午体育课密林迎战多批次突袭魔物，攻防连招无缝衔接，极限肃清后山裂隙溢出的暗黑能量。
三场接连不断的灵力透支，对于刚刚解封三年封印、本源根基尚未完全稳固的天野凛星而言，负荷早已远超身体所能承载的极限。
此刻褪去所有外界喧嚣，独处安静教室的空档，四肢百骸蔓延的酸软疲惫、经脉深处隐隐传来的干涩刺痛，才完完整整、清晰无比地浮现出来，时时刻刻提醒着他这场宿命的沉重与艰险。
少年修长白皙的指尖轻轻搭在课桌桌面，掌心微拢，一丝极淡、近乎透明的冰蓝色灵力微光顺着指尖缓缓流转、萦绕浮动。
澄澈纯净的冰之本源灵力温顺游走在周身经脉之中，一点点修复着白天激战受损的灵力脉络，缓慢填补体内亏空的本源力量。鎏金与冰白交织的细碎微光在他周身若隐若现，圣光本源温和熨帖着酸胀疲惫的肉身，冰系灵力沉静梳理着紊乱的气息，双属性本源相辅相成、相融共生，以最温和稳妥的方式加速着身体的复原。
他的眉眼依旧是少年独有的清隽温润，褪去了白日战斗时的凛冽杀伐，只剩下沉静安然，可眼底深处未曾彻底散去的警惕，却时时刻刻扎根心底。
三年人界蛰伏的平凡生活，早已让他习惯了收敛锋芒、藏起力量，习惯了独自承压、孤身扛责。哪怕身体早已疲惫透支，哪怕宿命重压无人分担，他也从未有过半分退缩懈怠的念头。
守护从来不是一时兴起的选择，而是刻入永霜王族血脉、融入灵魂骨血的毕生宿命。
只要暗影依旧盘踞世间，只要黑暗依旧觊觎人间安稳，只要这座学园、这片土地上还有无辜之人身处险境，他便会永远挺身而出，以少年单薄之躯，扛起整片光明的防线，独自隔绝所有黑暗凶险。
脖颈间佩戴的鎏金星刃吊坠静静贴在锁骨肌肤之上，微凉的触感平稳柔和，没有丝毫异动，没有传来往日预警的刺骨寒意。
这代表着此刻整片琉光星冕学园范围内，没有任何显性的暗影魔物活动，没有外露的暗黑戾气波动，整片校园处于绝对安全的状态。
可天野凛星心底的警惕，却丝毫没有因此减半。
历经数场暗影交锋，他早已摸清暗蚀族的行事规律。寻常零散魔物的突袭，从来都只是黑暗势力试探性的诱饵，是微不足道的前置铺垫，真正致命的杀招，永远藏匿在极致的平静之后，于无人预料的静谧时刻骤然爆发。
白日后山密林涌现的多批次魔物，全部源自地底残存的暗影裂隙，那些魔物力量薄弱、智商低下、只会无脑强攻，仅仅是裂隙溢散能量凝聚的残次品，真正潜藏在裂隙深处、操控一切黑暗异动的核心存在，自始至终都未曾显露过半分踪迹。
那股隐匿在暗处、居高临下窥探一切的未知黑暗力量，才是真正值得忌惮、需要严防死守的致命威胁。
天野凛星缓缓睁开双眼，澄澈温润的桃花眼望向窗外沉沉夜色，目光穿透朦胧的晚风与漆黑的夜幕，遥遥望向学园后方那片被校方明令封禁、禁止任何人踏入的后山禁忌密林。
夜色笼罩之下的密林，彻底褪去白日的枝叶绿意，整片林区化作浓郁化不开的墨黑，交错缠绕的枝桠张牙舞爪地伸展在夜空之下，轮廓狰狞诡异，如同蛰伏已久的凶兽，静静盘踞在校园后方，无声吞吐着未知的凶险与幽暗。
白日被彻底肃清的暗影戾气看似消散无踪，可那道连通暗影界与人界的地底裂隙，从来没有真正闭合。
裂隙就像一道永不愈合的黑暗创口，扎根在这片土地深处，持续不断地孕育、滋生着黑暗力量，源源不断地为暗蚀族输送侵袭人间的能量。
今日的平静肃清，不过是暂时压制了黑暗的躁动，根本无法彻底根除隐患。
“零星魔物不断涌现，裂隙持续溢散黑暗，暗处的操控者始终隐匿不出。”
天野凛星薄唇轻启，轻声自语，清冽的少年嗓音在空旷安静的教室之中缓缓回荡，温和的语气里藏着不容动摇的沉稳与凝重。
“试探已经结束，接下来，便是真正的围剿猎杀。”
他比任何人都清楚黑暗势力的贪婪与偏执。
暗影族群素来记仇且极具针对性，在见识到冰之守护者的觉醒力量、见识到这片学园潜藏的光明力量之后，绝对不会善罢甘休。对方必然已经锁定了自己的存在，摸清了自己的作息轨迹与力量特性，正在暗中布局，等待最佳的猎杀时机。
今夜极致的安宁，根本不是危机落幕的征兆，而是暴风雨来临之前，最致命、最危险的短暂沉寂。
危险已然临近，猎杀已然开局。
只是此刻的他，尚且不知，暗处布局的从来不是普通的暗影将领，而是执掌半数暗蚀族势力、高居黑暗权力顶端的暗樱女王；他更不会知晓，这场专为自己设下的必死杀局，会彻底打破两人小心翼翼维系的同窗平衡，会让藏于暗处、隐忍良久的满心倾慕，终究冲破所有克制，化作一场不顾一切、以身护誓的盛大救赎。
晚风再次穿窗涌入，轻轻拂过少年柔软的发丝，带起一丝微弱的凉意。
天野凛星缓缓收拢指尖流转的灵力，所有外放的感知尽数收回体内，周身淡淡的冰金微光瞬间敛去无踪，彻底变回那个温润谦和、平凡普通的学园班长模样，凌厉锋芒尽数藏于骨血，不对外人显露分毫。
他抬手轻轻按压酸胀的眉心，梳理着纷乱的思绪，默默规划着后续的巡查与戒备方案。
接下来的日子，后山密林将是重中之重的排查区域，他必须加大巡查频次，全天候监测裂隙能量波动，一旦发现高阶暗影力量异动，第一时间奔赴战场清缴，绝对不能让黑暗势力踏出密林半步，绝对不能让学园师生再次陷入险境。
就在天野凛星静心思索戒备方案、梳理后续防御布局的同一时刻。
琉光星冕学园行政楼顶层的学生会办公室内，灯火通明，暖意融融，与夜色里沉寂清冷的校园景致形成鲜明的对比。
宽敞雅致的办公室整洁规整，原木色的办公桌椅一尘不染，桌面整齐堆叠着今日汇总完毕的社团报备资料、班级评优档案、学生会工作台账，分类收纳、条理清晰，处处彰显着使用者细致稳妥、一丝不苟的处事风格。
落地窗外是整片校园的绝美夜景，细碎星光与校园路灯的暖光交相辉映，铺洒出一片温柔静谧的夜色光景。
content_en:
When twilight completely soaked the entire world of Ryukou Hoshimori Comprehensive Academy, all the lively fireworks in the bustling campus during the day had faded.
Layers of dark night cover slowly spread from the end of the sky, swallowing up the last rays of the setting sun. The clear night sky was dotted with scattered stars. The weak starlight fell through the thick night sky and fell on the scattered roofs of teaching buildings, the flat and open sports fields, and the lush star-patterned sycamore forests, coating the entire quiet campus with a cold, thin silver-white soft light.
The evening wind passed through the gaps between the buildings, slowly carrying the cool water vapor after dark, and picked up the golden dead leaves falling from the trees on both sides of the road. The leaves flew and circled, falling on the smooth bluestone pavement, making a soft and fine friction sound, becoming the only lively movement in the silent night.
The campus, which had experienced two attacks by shadow monsters and several consumption of spiritual power during the day, had been completely purified at this moment. There was no longer any cold and violent dark energy in the air, only the grass wrapped in the evening breeze was left. The fragrance of the wood and the unique crisp breath of the night are peaceful, quiet and gentle, as if the thrilling battle in the jungle during the day and the dark crisis sweeping the school were just fleeting illusions.
But only the two people who stand at the center of the dark destiny know that under the calm surface, the undercurrent has long been turbulent and dormant, and the fatal crisis has never really been far away from this academy, which is secretly targeted by the shadow forces.
The teaching building of Class 1, Grade 2, has long been sparsely lit, and most of the classrooms on the entire floor have turned off the lights. Only scattered emergency night lights on both sides of the corridor are left, emitting soft and warm light, lightly illuminating the empty and silent corridor. It has been a quarter of an hour since the end of the evening self-study bell. Almost all the students in the school have left school and gone home. The few students who stayed in school for self-study have already packed their schoolbags and left. The huge teaching area has completely lost the bustle of people during the day and fell into silence.
Amano Rinxei sat alone in the window seat, not packing up his books and leaving school on time as usual.
The glass window of the classroom was completely open, and the cool evening breeze flowed in through the window, gently blowing the fine black hair on the young man's forehead, and also blowing the textbook pages spread out on the corner of the table. The paper was gently rolled, making a regular and soft clattering sound. The young man's posture is upright and straight, his back is leaning straight on the back of the chair, his eyes are lightly closed, and his expression is calm and peaceful. The breath around his body is relaxed but not completely off guard. The whole person is in a state of deep breath control.
The continuous high-intensity battles during the day still left indelible spiritual energy loss and limb soreness in his body.
Faced with the siege of hundreds of shadow monsters in the early morning, he continuously activated the dual source spiritual power of the Ice Saints throughout the process, and successively used the four basic moves to clear the entire area, protect students with a barrier, and purify the darkness; during the lunch break, he walked around the corners and cracks of the campus, one inch at a time. Investigate and purify the hidden shadow remnants, and continue to consume thin spiritual power to maintain global awareness; in the afternoon physical education class, the dense forest faces multiple batches of attacking monsters, with seamless offensive and defensive combos, and the ultimate clearing of the dark energy overflowing from the cracks in the back mountain.
Three consecutive spiritual power overdrafts, for Amano Rinxei, who had just released the three-year seal and whose original foundation was not yet completely solid, the load had already far exceeded the limit that his body could bear.
At this moment, all the external noise faded away, and he was alone in the quiet classroom. The soreness and fatigue spreading throughout his limbs and the dry and stinging pain from the depths of his meridians emerged completely and clearly, reminding him of the weight and danger of this fate.
The young man's slender white fingertips gently rested on the desk top, his palms were slightly closed, and a very light, almost transparent glimmer of ice-blue spiritual power slowly flowed and lingered along the fingertips.
The clear and pure spiritual energy of the ice flows docilely in the meridians all over the body, gradually repairing the spiritual energy channels damaged by the fierce battle during the day, and slowly filling the missing original power in the body. The tiny shimmer of gilded gold and ice white loomed around him. The source of holy light gently ironed the sore and tired body, and the ice spiritual power calmly sorted out the chaotic atmosphere. The dual attribute sources complemented each other, blended and symbiotically, accelerating the body's recovery in the most gentle and safe way.
His brows and eyes still have the unique gentleness and gentleness of a young man. The fierceness of the day's battle has faded away, leaving only calmness and tranquility. However, the vigilance deep in his eyes has not completely dissipated, but it is always rooted in his heart.
Three years of ordinary life dormant in the human world had already made him accustomed to restraining his edge, hiding his strength, and becoming accustomed to bearing pressure and shouldering responsibilities alone. Even though his body was already exhausted, even if no one shared the weight of his fate, he never had the slightest thought of shrinking back.
Guardianship is never a spur-of-the-moment choice, but a lifelong destiny engraved in the blood of the Yongshuang royal family and integrated into the bones and blood of the soul.
As long as the shadows still dominate the world, as long as the darkness still covets the stability of the world, as long as there are innocent people in danger in this school and this land, he will always stand up and use his young body to hold up the entire defense line of light and isolate all darkness and dangers alone.
The gilt star blade pendant worn around the neck rested quietly on the skin of the collarbone. The slightly cool touch was smooth and soft, without any movement or the biting chill that had been warned in the past.
This means that at this moment, there are no obvious shadow monster activities, no exposed dark violent energy fluctuations in the entire Liuguang Xingmian Academy, and the entire campus is in an absolutely safe state.
But Amano Rinxing's vigilance in his heart was not reduced by half.
After several shadow battles, he had already figured out the behavior of the Dark Eclipse clan. The raids of ordinary and scattered monsters have always been just tentative baits for the dark forces, a negligible foreshadowing. The truly fatal killing moves are always hidden behind the ultimate calm, and suddenly erupt in a quiet moment that no one expects.
The many batches of monsters that emerged in the dense forest of the back mountain during the day all originated from the remaining shadow fissures underground. Those monsters were weak in strength, low in IQ, and could only attack without thinking. They were just defective products condensed by the energy leaked from the fissures. The core existence that truly lurked deep in the fissures and controlled all the dark movements had never been revealed from the beginning to the end.
The unknown dark force that hides in the dark and peeks into everything from a high position is the real deadly threat that deserves to be feared and needs to be guarded against.
Amano Rinxei slowly opened his eyes, his clear and warm peach blossom eyes looked out the window at the dark night, his eyes penetrated the hazy evening breeze and the dark night, and looked far away at the forbidden forest behind the academy that was banned by the school and no one was allowed to enter.
The dense forest under the cover of night has completely lost the green branches and leaves during the day, and the entire forest area has turned into a dense and indestructible black. The intertwined branches stretch out under the night sky with claws and claws, and the outline is ferocious and strange, like a long-dormant beast, quietly entrenched behind the campus, silently breathing unknown danger and darkness.
The evil energy of the shadows that had been completely purged during the day seemed to have disappeared without a trace, but the underground fissure connecting the shadow world and the human world had never truly closed.
The rift is like a dark wound that never heals. It is rooted deep in this land, constantly nurturing and breeding the power of darkness, and continuously delivering the energy that invades the world to the Eclipse tribe.
Today's calm purge only temporarily suppresses the restlessness of darkness, and cannot completely eradicate the hidden dangers.
"Scattered monsters continue to emerge, the cracks continue to overflow with darkness, and the controller in the darkness can never hide."
Amano Rinxing opened her thin lips and whispered softly to himself. The clear young voice slowly echoed in the empty and quiet classroom. There was an unshakable calmness and solemnity hidden in the gentle tone.
"The temptation is over, and now comes the real encirclement and hunting."
He knows better than anyone the greed and paranoia of the dark forces.
The shadow tribe has always been vengeful and highly targeted. After witnessing the awakening power of the Ice Guardian and seeing the power of light hidden in this academy, they will never give up. The opponent must have locked onto his existence, figured out his daily routine and strength characteristics, and is secretly making plans, waiting for the best opportunity to hunt.
The ultimate tranquility tonight is not a sign of the end of the crisis at all, but the most deadly and dangerous short silence before the storm.
Danger is approaching and the hunt has begun.
But at this moment, he didn't know that the one who planned the secret plan was never an ordinary shadow general, but the Queen of Dark Sakura, who controlled half of the forces of the Dark Eclipse tribe and stood at the top of the dark power. He also didn't know that this fatal killing situation set for him would completely break the balance that the two carefully maintained as classmates, and that the admiration that had been hidden in the dark and endured for a long time would finally break through all restraints and turn into a grand redemption that was risking everything and protecting the oath with one's body.
The evening breeze flowed in through the window again, gently blowing through the young man's soft hair, bringing with it a faint chill.
Amano Rinxei slowly gathered the spiritual power flowing through his fingertips, and retracted all the external feelings into his body. The faint ice-gold shimmer around him instantly disappeared without a trace, and he completely transformed back into the gentle, humble, ordinary school monitor. All his sharp edges were hidden in his bones and blood, and he did not reveal anything to outsiders.
He raised his hand and gently pressed the sore eyebrows, sorted out his chaotic thoughts, and silently planned the follow-up inspection and alert plan.
In the days to come, the dense forest in the back mountain will be the top priority area for investigation. He must increase the frequency of inspections and monitor the energy fluctuations of the cracks around the clock. Once he discovers any changes in the high-level shadow power, he will rush to the battlefield to clear it as soon as possible. He must not let the dark forces take a step out of the dense forest, and must not let the teachers and students of the academy fall into danger again.
At the same moment when Amano Rinsei was thinking about the alert plan and sorting out the subsequent defense layout.
The student union office on the top floor of the administrative building of Ryukou Seimian Academy is brightly lit and warm, in sharp contrast to the quiet and cold campus scene at night.
The spacious and elegant office is neat and orderly, with spotless wood-colored office desks and chairs. The club registration materials, class evaluation files, and student union work ledgers that have been compiled today are neatly stacked on the desktop. They are classified and organized in a clear manner, demonstrating the user's meticulous and meticulous work style.
Outside the floor-to-ceiling windows is a beautiful night view of the entire campus. The fine starlight and the warm light of the campus street lights complement each other, creating a gentle and quiet night scene.
title_en: Chapter 3: Emberthorn Red Lotus protects the oath with its body Chapter 4: The omen of the reverberating twins in the divine realm
